tooltip.citiesinlife.wand_1: Right click: place a corner, then right click again to finish
tooltip.citiesinlife.wand_2: Up / Down: choose a building type  |  Left click: confirm
tooltip.citiesinlife.wand_3: Sneak + right click: clear the selection
hud.citiesinlife.right_click_start: Right click to place corner A
hud.citiesinlife.structure_mode_hint: Draw a box with the Planner Wand to delete registrations
screen.citiesinlife.no_city_hint: Select a building as City Core to found one
screen.citiesinlife.map_controls: Left click: claim   Right click: release
screen.citiesinlife.found_hint: This building becomes your city hall.
message.citiesinlife.no_floors: No usable floors found. Try the Block Volume mode (right arrow) - it measures enclosed space instead of storeys.
message.citiesinlife.no_interior: No enclosed space found in there. It needs walls, a floor and something overhead.
message.citiesinlife.too_far: That selection is too far away.
message.citiesinlife.too_large: That selection is too large to measure.
message.citiesinlife.already_have_city: You already have a city in this world.
message.citiesinlife.no_city: Found a city first: select a building as City Core.
message.citiesinlife.not_your_land: Your city does not own all the ground under that.
message.citiesinlife.bad_name: That city name is not valid.
message.citiesinlife.name_taken: A city with that name already exists.
message.citiesinlife.chunk_owned: Another city already owns that chunk.
message.citiesinlife.cannot_unclaim: You cannot release a chunk with one of your structures on it.
message.citiesinlife.not_adjacent: Claims must touch your existing territory.
tooltip.citiesinlife.line_1: Right click one power block, then another, to run a line
tooltip.citiesinlife.line_2: Sneak + right click the second one to cut the line instead
tooltip.citiesinlife.line_3: Solar Panel or Turbine -> Power Mast -> Transit Station in your city
hud.citiesinlife.line_started: Line started at %s, %s, %s - click the other end
screen.citiesinlife.power_short: Not enough power - the city has stopped growing
message.citiesinlife.nothing_in_area: No registrations of yours in that box.
message.citiesinlife.not_power_block: Both ends must be a solar panel, turbine, power mast or transit station.
message.citiesinlife.not_linked: There is no line between those two.
message.citiesinlife.too_far_apart: Too far apart: %s blocks, and the shorter end only reaches %s.
message.citiesinlife.too_tall: That selection is too tall to measure.
screen.citiesinlife.boiler_powering: Running - steam going to the turbine
screen.citiesinlife.boiler_venting: Running - no turbine found, steam wasted
screen.citiesinlife.boiler_no_chamber: Not sealed in - wall the boiler in on all sides
screen.citiesinlife.boiler_no_water: No water - put a water bucket in the top slot
screen.citiesinlife.boiler_no_fuel: No fuel - put coal in the bottom slot
message.citiesinlife.registered_plant: Registered %s - the boiler inside will now look here for a turbine and a chimney
screen.citiesinlife.boiler_no_outlet: Smoke has nowhere to go - add a Chimney with open sky above it, or leave a hole straight above
screen.citiesinlife.delete_city_body: That box has your city hall in it. Deleting it deletes the whole city: %s buildings, %s claimed chunks and %s in the treasury. You can found a new city afterwards, but nothing here comes back.
